subject: ddl: do not reference owner_id for all system DDLs (#53355)
summary: Changes MDL info registration/cleanup to omit `owner_id` for any DDL whose target schema is a system DB (`mysql`/`sys`), instead of only special-casing `mysql.tidb_mdl_info`. This avoids referencing a possibly-nonexistent `owner_id` column during bootstrap/upgrade system DDLs; no remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched DDL/MDL metadata/state handling.
